zh.what: 从已配对遥控器请 Agent 发文件或在对话里附图时，修复了 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 中有时操作已获允许、文件却没有送出的问题。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: Fixed an issue where a file or image could fail to send from a paired remote after Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode had allowed the command.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: 可以在已绑定的微信私聊里请 Agent 把工作目录里的文件发回来。文件只会发回提出请求的那个微信。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: In your linked WeChat chat, you can ask Agent J for a file from its working folder. It sends the file back to the WeChat account that asked.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: 以后升级时，Agent J 会清理用不到的旧下载，保留回退所需的安装包。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: On future updates, Agent J clears old downloads it no longer needs and keeps the packages needed to roll back.
